people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
translations.bsb: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
translations.asv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
